summary: Fixed 4 HIGH priority security issues in digital-twin-service

key_changes: Added JWT authentication middleware (authenticateJWT) to all 3 endpoints
Added rate limiting middleware (createGeneralRateLimiter) to prevent DoS attacks
Added UUID validation for patientId parameter to prevent injection attacks
Updated controller functions to use AuthenticatedRequest type for type safety
Updated test file to use AuthenticatedRequest type - all 8 tests passing

security_improvements.before: Routes completely unprotected - any unauthenticated user could access patient health data
security_improvements.after: Defense-in-depth: JWT auth + rate limiting + input validation
issues_fixed: Missing authentication middleware - FIXED with authenticateJWT
Missing rate limiting - FIXED with createGeneralRateLimiter
Missing input validation - FIXED with validateUUID
Tests not executed - FIXED, all 8 tests passing
